SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName AS category,
    sum(fos.SalesAmount) AS total_sales_amount,
    sum(fos.SalesQuantity) AS total_sales_quantity,
    sum(fos.SalesAmount) - sum(fos.TotalCost) AS gross_margin_amount,
    (sum(fos.SalesAmount) - sum(fos.TotalCost)) / nullIf(sum(fos.SalesAmount), 0) AS gross_margin_pct,
    sum(fos.ReturnQuantity) / nullIf(sum(fos.SalesQuantity), 0) AS return_rate,
    sum(fos.SalesAmount) / nullIf(countDistinct(fos.SalesOrderNumber), 0) AS average_order_value
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS fos
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON fos.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps
    ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc
    ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
WHERE pc.ProductCategoryName = 'Cameras'
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
